Rajnath Singh warns terrorists of 'home invasion' policy

Defence Minister Rajnath Singh stated that India's zero tolerance for terrorism is a "line of action," not just a statement. He invoked "Operation Sindoor" and issued a stern warning to terrorists, vowing to "strike by entering their home." Singh also detailed India's defence overhaul, emphasizing the role of AI, cybersecurity, and robotics in the nation's self-reliant defence future.
